claims.statement: At Deir el-Medina in western Thebes, a community of artists and craftspeople created royal tombs and left evidence of everyday life.

evidence.locator: Paragraphs on royal tombs and the town of Deir el-Medina
evidence.note: Shown within broad New Kingdom context from the source, not as exact settlement foundation and abandonment dates. A site-specific map reference has not yet been checked.

sources.title: Egypt in the New Kingdom (ca. 1550–1070 BCE)
sources.creator: Catharine H. Roehrig, The Metropolitan Museum of Art
